newsitem.title: USA: Northern Trust Q4 trust fees up 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Northern Trust Q4 trust fees up 14 percent.

text.p: Northern Trust Corp said Tuesday its trust fees grew 14 percent to a record $152 million in the fourth quarter, up from $133.6 million a year ago.
Trust fees represent 49 percent of revenue and 76 percent of non-interest income, the bank holding company said.
Foreign exchange trading profits rose to $16.1 million in the quarter from $12.3 million a year ago, while net interest income rose to $108.4 million from $100.7 million in the year ago quarter.

Credit quality improved, with non-performing assets of $21.4 million at the end of the year, the lowest level in 15 years, Northern Trust said. Non-performing assets were $33.7 million at the end of 1995.
Non-interest expenses were $199.9 million in the quarter, up $21.4 million from the year ago period, due to several growth initiatives, the company said.
Earlier Tuesday, Northern Trust reported net income of $67.4 million, or $0.58 a diluted share in the fourth quarter, compared to $59.5 million, or $0.50 a share a year ago.
Northern Trust shares were down 1/4 at 40-1/4 Tuesday.
